Connecting Trade, Supply and Investment Opportunities

settings.editor: AXELA Limited is a Dhaka based trading, indenting, commercial brokerage and business advisory company. We connect buyers, suppliers, project owners and prospective investors to support product sourcing, supply requirements, tender opportunities and investment proposals.

From commodity sourcing and commercial coordination to investment opportunity origination and corporate advisory, we help clients assess requirements, engage relevant counterparties and progress business opportunities.

AXELA Limited works at the intersection of international trade, product supply and commercial advisory. Our role is to help identify opportunities, connect relevant parties and coordinate the commercial steps required to move a transaction forward.
We aim to build business relationships through clear communication, professional conduct, confidentiality and a practical understanding of buyer and supplier requirements.
Sourcing and coordinating supply of petroleum products, commercial brokerage, tender support and advisory services.

Sourcing and coordinating supply of petroleum products, petrochemicals, fertilizers, industrial chemicals and other agreed commodities or commercial products, subject to product availability, applicable approvals and agreed contract terms.
Introducing buyers and suppliers, facilitating commercial discussions, coordinating offers and supporting transactions under agreed mandates and commission arrangements.
Identifying relevant supply tenders and assisting with supplier coordination, quotations, product specifications, commercial documentation and bid or contract coordination where authorised.
Helping clarify product requirements, quantity, quality specifications, origin, delivery schedule and trade terms; coordinating enquiries with potential suppliers and service providers.
Identifying and developing business proposals, project concepts, strategic partnerships and investment opportunities for review by potential local and international investors.

Supporting international investors with local introductions, opportunity screening, business coordination and communication with relevant counterparties. Legal, tax, licensing and regulated services should be provided by appropriately qualified professionals.
Commercial support for business plans, transaction structures, strategic partnerships, capital proposals and financing discussions, working with relevant professional advisers where required.

Coordinating commercial documentation, delivery requirements, shipment-related communication and counterparty follow-up as agreed for each transaction. AXELA does not represent itself as a carrier, insurer or logistics operator unless separately authorised to provide those services.
AXELA LTD. may consider sourcing and supply enquiries across the following categories, depending on the specific requirement, supplier availability, applicable permissions and transaction terms.
Diesel, gasoil, fuel oil, jet fuel, LNG, bitumen and other petroleum products where permitted and available.
Selected petrochemical feedstocks, aromatics, olefins, and industrial raw materials for processing facilities.
Granular and prilled Urea, DAP, NPK compounds, potash (MOP), and key agricultural soil enrichment inputs.
Essential industrial process chemicals, solvents, caustics, and water treatment reagents under strict quality control.
Rice, milling wheat, feed grains, pulses, refined sugar, and edible oils tailored to institutional and national requirements.
Industrial raw materials, steel scrap, iron ore, clinker, capital equipment, and commercial goods based on verified tenders.
A structured, transparent and disciplined methodology guiding commercial discussions from initial enquiry to contract execution.
Confirm product or project scope, specifications, volume, destination, timing and commercial terms.
Coordinate with suitable suppliers, buyers, project owners, advisers or investors.
Support discussion of price basis, delivery terms, documentation, payment conditions and responsibilities.
Help keep communication, documents and agreed follow-up steps organised.
Promote confidentiality, transparent communication, responsible business conduct and compliance.
Tracking physical crude, refined products, LNG, fertilizers and commercial commodities across key international maritime trade corridors.

settings.title: Facilitating Inbound Capital & Strategic Project Development

settings.editor: Depending on the mandate, activities may include preparing an initial opportunity summary, identifying prospective investors or strategic partners, arranging introductions, coordinating preliminary discussions and helping organise commercial information for review.

• Opportunity Summary & Concept Structuring
• Local Introductions & Inbound Investor Screening
• Commercial Information Organization & Transaction Alignment

All investment opportunities are subject to independent due diligence, applicable regulatory requirements, definitive documentation and agreement between the relevant parties. Website information is not an offer to sell securities or a guarantee of investment performance.
AXELA LTD. aims to conduct business with integrity, professionalism and respect for applicable laws and contractual obligations.
We value clear mandates, accurate commercial documentation and responsible engagement with suppliers, buyers, investors and institutional counterparties.
Protecting counterparty proprietary intelligence, pricing structures, trade strategies and non-disclosure obligations throughout all transaction stages.
Product transactions and advisory assignments remain subject to relevant licensing, sanctions screening, customs, tax, and governance compliance requirements.
For product supply enquiries, tender opportunities, commercial mandates, investment proposals or advisory requirements, contact AXELA LTD. to discuss the scope and potential next steps.
